title: موسوعة الآيات القرآنية عن الصبر، السعي، الدعاء، والفرج

verses.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
verses.translation_en: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

verses.text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
verses.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

verses.text: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
verses.translation_en: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.

verses.text: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation_en: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.

verses.text: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
verses.translation_en: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him].

verses.text: الَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
verses.translation_en: Those to whom hypocrites said, 'Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them.' But it increased them in faith, and they said, 'Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.'

verses.text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.translation_en: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may succeed.

verses.text: وَاصْبِرُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
verses.translation_en: And be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

verses.text: وَقُلِ اعْمَلُوا فَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation_en: And say, 'Work, for Allah will see your work, and [so will] His Messenger and the believers.'

verses.text: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ
verses.translation_en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty.

verses.text: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translation_en: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good.

verses.text: وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
verses.translation_en: And despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.

verses.text: إِنَّهُ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translation_en: Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

verses.text: سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ
verses.translation_en: Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home.

verses.text: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
verses.translation_en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

verses.text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً
verses.translation_en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life.

verses.text: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضِيقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.translation_en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.

verses.text: إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
verses.translation_en: When the youths fled to the cave and said, 'Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.'

verses.text: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا
verses.translation_en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deed.

verses.text: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
verses.translation_en: And never is your Lord forgetful.

verses.text: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي
verses.translation_en: [Moses] said, 'My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance].'

verses.text: وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
verses.translation_en: 'And ease for me my task.'

verses.text: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
verses.translation_en: And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'

verses.text: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا
verses.translation_en: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting.

verses.text: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
verses.translation_en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

verses.text: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكِ نُنجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation_en: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

verses.text: أُولَٰئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا
verses.translation_en: Those will be awarded the Highest Place for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and peace.

verses.text: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
verses.translation_en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

verses.text: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translation_en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.

verses.text: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا ۖ وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.translation_en: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

verses.text: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.translation_en: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.

verses.text: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
verses.theme: الأمل وعدم القنوط من رحمة الله
verses.translation_en: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'

verses.text: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
verses.translation_en: And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.'

verses.text: وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translation_en: And not is granted it except those who are patient, and not is granted it except one who has great fortune.

verses.text: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.translation_en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives.

verses.text: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
verses.translation_en: And that his effort is going to be seen.

verses.text: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
verses.translation_en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.

verses.text: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ
verses.translation_en: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose.

verses.text: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ
verses.translation_en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

verses.text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verses.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
